verdict.rationale: Angular is a web framework, and its ecosystem (e.g., the CLI) could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions AI-forward resources, prompts, best practices and an llms.txt file. These are adjacent developer resources, not an assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
